items.do_not: Do not add mail.thread to plasticos.freight.estimate. The model is immutable evidence and cannot post chatter.
items.proof: A registry load prints no unknown parameter 'tracking' for plasticos.freight.estimate.status. status is still stored on the estimate row.
items.why_open: plasticos.freight.estimate does not inherit mail.thread, and no other module inherits it. Odoo 19 Field.setup warns once for each unknown parameter. mail.thread._valid_field_parameter is what makes tracking legal. write() lists status as immutable, so the parameter cannot emit a change note. The load records the result with message_post and a freight_estimate_persisted or freight_estimate_rejected event. The warning prints on every registry load.
items.action: Delete tracking=True from status. Keep the column. The stored value and the load audit path stay.
